- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:171-177 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts dead-code patterns instead of the code path that actually executes.
  WHY: The reviewer says the checked strings exist, but they are not the live implementation the test is meant to validate.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:186,243 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test references `ORCHESTRATE_POLL_SCRIPT`, but the file defines `ORCHESTRATE_POLL_PROCESS`.
  WHY: The reviewer says this would raise `NameError` before assertions run; other reviewers called it a false positive.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:180-182,237-239 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts `_build_judge_semble_prefetch`, which the reviewer says does not match the actual implementation string it should check.
  WHY: The reviewer says the assertion will fail because the underscore-prefixed name is not the live helper; other reviewers disputed this as a false positive.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:281 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The call uses `build_judge_semble_prefetch`, which the reviewer says does not exist in this file.
  WHY: The reviewer says `set -euo pipefail` would abort on the undefined function call.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:158,284 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `build_judge_semble_prefetch()` checks a weaker availability guard than `_build_judge_semble_prefetch()`.
  WHY: The reviewer says the newer path can still call `semble_query_block` when Semble is sourced but unavailable or unindexed, unlike the wrapper.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:131,264 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The file contains two Semble prefetch helpers with divergent guard logic and query construction.
  WHY: The reviewer says the dual-helper setup makes it easy to wire the wrong one and is a maintainability risk.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:134-317 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The workflow YAML checks are static string-search tests and do not exercise the bash workflow under realistic runtime conditions.
  WHY: The reviewer says they cannot catch env-dependent failures such as sourcing/install issues or mismatched Semble availability.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9476,9492-9506 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_PREFETCH=""` is set unconditionally before the pipe assignment.
  WHY: The reviewer says the empty initialization is dead/unnecessary and leaves an empty value if the later pipe fails.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
